name: dblab
description: Interactive terminal-based database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle with modern UI and comprehensive features

dblab.description: Modern database client TUI supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle with SSH tunneling, SSL, and advanced query features
dblab.usage:
dblab --url 'postgres://user:pass@host:port/db' # Connect to PostgreSQL
dblab --driver mysql --host localhost --user root --db mydb # MySQL connection
dblab --config # Use config file
dblab --ssh-host server --ssh-user admin # SSH tunnel
dblab --ssl strict --sslcert cert.pem # SSL connection
